notes: The existential אַיִן heads on none, with the supplied dummy and copula in its unit (rule 50).
The assimilated article of כָּאֵל is unrepresented, since the ASV writes like unto God with no the (rule 12).
upon the heavens and on the skies are supplied prepositions for accusatives of place, belonging to those nouns (rules 33, 15).
